<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Esha Salmith</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Onest:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#05060f;--ink:#f4f7ff;--muted:#b4c0e0;--sky:#38bdf8;--indigo:#6366f1;--line:rgba(244,247,255,.18);--glass:rgba(8,10,28,.55);
  box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#05060f;--ink:#f4f7ff}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#05060f;--ink:#f4f7ff}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:300 17px/1.7 Onest,system-ui,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
h1,h2,h3{font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.012em;margin:0;line-height:1.1}
.grad{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#fff,var(--sky) 55%,var(--indigo));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
/* fixed world */
#stage{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
#stars{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0}
#code{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;opacity:.5}
#stars i{position:absolute;width:2px;height:2px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;animation:tw 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes tw{to{opacity:.2}}
.ly{position:absolute;left:-6%;width:112%;bottom:0;will-change:transform}
.ly svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
#prog{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:3px;width:0;z-index:30;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--sky),var(--indigo))}
/* dock */
.dock{position:fixed;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 14px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:20;display:flex;gap:2px;padding:6px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);max-width:calc(100% - 20px)}
.dock a{padding:8px 15px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;will-change:transform;transition:color .2s,background .2s}
.dock a:hover{color:#fff;background:rgba(99,102,241,.4)}
@media(max-width:560px){.dock a{padding:8px 10px;font-size:.78rem}.dock a:nth-child(5){display:none}}
/* scenes */
main{position:relative;z-index:2}
.scene{min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:110px 22px 80px}
.in-wrap{max-width:1040px;width:100%;margin:0 auto}
.hero .in-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:40px;align-items:center}
@media(max-width:800px){.hero .in-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center}.btns{justify-content:center}.ph{order:-1}}
.eyebrow{letter-spacing:.32em;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--sky)}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.5rem,9vw,5.8rem);font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.12em;margin:14px 0 18px}
.role{color:var(--muted);max-width:560px}@media(max-width:800px){.role{margin:0 auto}}
.btns{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:32px}
.plasma{position:relative;display:inline-block;padding:15px 34px;border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;border:1px solid rgba(125,211,252,.55);color:#fff;font:inherit;background:none;cursor:pointer}
.plasma::before,.plasma::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-60%;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 40%,var(--sky),transparent 40%),radial-gradient(circle at 70% 60%,var(--indigo),transparent 45%),radial-gradient(circle at 50% 80%,#1e1b4b,transparent 50%);filter:blur(14px);animation:spin 7s linear infinite}
.plasma::after{animation-duration:11s;animation-direction:reverse;opacity:.7}
.plasma:hover{box-shadow:0 0 34px rgba(99,102,241,.7)}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.ghost{padding:15px 30px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--glass);transition:.25s}.ghost:hover{border-color:var(--sky);color:var(--sky)}
.ph{position:relative;width:min(340px,74vw);aspect-ratio:1;justify-self:center;transition:transform .15s ease-out;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.ph::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-6px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(var(--sky),var(--indigo),#fff,var(--sky));animation:spin 8s linear infinite;box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(99,102,241,.5)}
.ph img{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 18%;border:5px solid #0a0c24;display:block}
.panel{background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:clamp(22px,4vw,44px);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,5vw,3rem);margin-bottom:26px}
.two{display:grid;gap:34px;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr}@media(max-width:760px){.two{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.panel p{margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--muted)}
.facts{border-left:2px solid var(--indigo);padding-left:20px;display:grid;gap:14px}.facts span{display:block;font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--sky)}
.timeline{border-left:1px solid var(--line);margin-left:6px}
.step{position:relative;padding:0 0 30px 28px}.step:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.step::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-6px;top:8px;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sky);box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--sky)}
.yr{font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--sky)}.step h3{font-size:1.35rem;margin:4px 0 2px}.step p{margin:0}
.skillgrp{margin-bottom:22px}.skillgrp:last-child{margin-bottom:0}.skillgrp h3{font-size:1rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:10px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}.chip{padding:7px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;font-size:.9rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);transition:.25s}.chip:hover{border-color:var(--sky);background:rgba(56,189,248,.15)}
.cards{display:grid;gap:16px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr))}
.pcard{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 12px 18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);transition:transform .35s,border-color .35s}
.pcard:hover{transform:translateY(-6px) rotateX(3deg);border-color:var(--sky)}
.pframe{aspect-ratio:16/10;border-radius:8px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 30%,rgba(56,189,248,.55),transparent 55%),linear-gradient(135deg,#14163a,#0a0b1e);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.2em;margin-bottom:14px}
.pcard h3{font-size:1.15rem;margin-bottom:6px}.pcard p{font-size:.9rem;margin:0 0 10px}.plinks{display:flex;gap:14px;font-size:.86rem}.plinks a{color:var(--sky)}
form{display:grid;gap:14px}
input,textarea{width:100%;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);color:var(--ink);font:inherit}
input:focus,textarea:focus,a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--sky);outline-offset:2px}
button.plasma{justify-self:start}
.social{display:grid;gap:10px;align-content:start}.social a{padding:13px 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);transition:.25s}.social a:hover{border-color:var(--indigo);transform:translateX(5px)}
footer{position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;padding:26px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem;background:rgba(2,3,10,.85)}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(34px) scale(.98);transition:opacity .9s,transform .9s}.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.rv{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}.plasma::before,.plasma::after,.ph::before,#stars i{animation:none}}

[hidden]{display:none!important}
/* hero + hanging ID card */
.hero{padding:0}
.hero .in-wrap{padding:110px 22px 80px;min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh}
.idwrap{position:relative;width:300px;justify-self:center;align-self:stretch;margin-top:-110px}
.lanyard{position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;width:280px;margin-left:-140px;transform-origin:50% 0;will-change:transform;touch-action:none;cursor:grab;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.lanyard.drag{cursor:grabbing}
.strap{position:relative;width:34px;height:max(110px,calc(50vh - 215px));height:max(110px,calc(50dvh - 215px));margin:0 auto;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1e1b4b,#6366f1 30%,#38bdf8 50%,#6366f1 70%,#1e1b4b);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(99,102,241,.5)}
.strap::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0 22px,rgba(255,255,255,.35) 22px 24px)}
.clip{position:relative;z-index:2;width:30px;height:38px;margin:-6px auto -18px;border-radius:6px 6px 10px 10px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#e5e7eb,#9ca3af 60%,#6b7280);box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.clip::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:7px;width:12px;height:6px;margin-left:-6px;border-radius:3px;background:#0a0c24}
.idcard{position:relative;width:280px;height:400px;border-radius:18px;padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#10132f,#0a0c24 60%,#14163a);border:1px solid rgba(125,211,252,.4);box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.55),0 0 40px rgba(99,102,241,.35);will-change:transform}
.slot{position:absolute;top:12px;left:50%;width:46px;height:8px;margin-left:-23px;border-radius:6px;background:#05060f;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.8),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.idtop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:16px;font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--sky)}
.idtop b{font-weight:400}.idtop i{font-style:normal;color:var(--muted)}
.idphoto{flex:1;min-height:0;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff}
.idphoto img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 26%;display:block;pointer-events:none}
.idname{font-size:1.25rem;letter-spacing:.14em;line-height:1.1}
.idrole{font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--sky);margin-top:-6px}
.idbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--muted)}
.bars{width:96px;height:24px;opacity:.85;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#f4f7ff 0 2px,transparent 2px 4px,#f4f7ff 4px 5px,transparent 5px 8px,#f4f7ff 8px 11px,transparent 11px 13px)}
.shine{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent calc(var(--sh,50%) - 22%),rgba(255,255,255,.16),transparent calc(var(--sh,50%) + 22%))}
@media(max-width:800px){.idwrap{order:-1;height:600px;align-self:auto;width:100%}.strap{height:170px}.hero .in-wrap{min-height:0}}
/* project stack */
.pstack{position:relative;height:540px;max-width:640px;margin:10px auto 0;perspective:1200px;outline:none}
.pk{position:absolute;left:0;top:56px;width:calc(100% - 96px);padding:14px 14px 20px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(22,24,64,.97),rgba(8,10,28,.97));box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5);transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),opacity .4s;will-change:transform;cursor:grab}
.pk.front{border-color:rgba(125,211,252,.5);box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.55),0 0 40px rgba(99,102,241,.3)}
.pkimg{aspect-ratio:16/7;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.2em;background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 30%,rgba(56,189,248,.55),transparent 55%),linear-gradient(135deg,#14163a,#0a0b1e)}
.pkimg img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;pointer-events:none}
.pk h3{font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:6px}.pk p{font-size:.92rem;margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--muted)}
.pk .plinks a{padding:7px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.pnav{position:relative;z-index:5;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-top:6px;color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:520px){.pk{width:calc(100% - 56px)}.pstack{height:500px}}
/* buttons + admin */
.btn{padding:10px 16px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:var(--ink);font:inherit;font-size:.9rem;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--sky)}
.btn.pri{background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--sky),var(--indigo));border-color:transparent;color:#05060f}
footer a{color:var(--sky)}
#admin{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100}
.admbg{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(2,3,10,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.admpanel{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:min(480px,100%);overflow:auto;background:#0a0c24;border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px 22px 40px;font-size:.92rem}
.admpanel h3{font-size:.9rem;margin:26px 0 6px;color:var(--sky);letter-spacing:.2em}
.admpanel label{display:block;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);margin:10px 0 4px}
.admpanel .row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
.admpanel .note{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px}
.admbar{position:sticky;top:-24px;z-index:2;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 0;background:#0a0c24}
.apj{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin-top:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.err{color:#fda4af;font-size:.85rem;min-height:1.2em;margin:8px 0 0}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:24px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:120;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:999px;background:#0a0c24;border:1px solid var(--sky);color:var(--ink);font-size:.9rem}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="prog"></div>
<div id="stage" aria-hidden="true">
  <div id="stars"></div><canvas id="code"></canvas>
  <div class="ly" id="l1"><svg viewBox="0 0 1200 300" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M0 220 L150 120 L280 190 L430 70 L600 200 L760 110 L930 190 L1200 90 V300 H0Z" fill="#3b3f9e" opacity=".55"/></svg></div>
  <div class="ly" id="l2"><svg viewBox="0 0 1200 260" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M0 200 L200 110 L370 180 L560 80 L760 190 L980 100 L1200 180 V260 H0Z" fill="#1e1f5c" opacity=".85"/></svg></div>
  <div class="ly" id="l3"><svg viewBox="0 0 1200 220" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M0 170 L160 120 L340 170 L520 110 L720 170 L940 120 L1200 170 V220 H0Z" fill="#070818"/></svg></div>
</div>

<nav class="dock" id="dock"><a href="#top">Home</a><a href="#about">About</a><a href="#education">Education</a><a href="#skills">Skills</a><a href="#projects">Projects</a><a href="#contact">Contact</a></nav>

<main>
<section class="scene hero" id="top"><div class="in-wrap">
  <div class="rv"><div class="eyebrow" id="eyebrow"></div><h1 class="grad" id="name"></h1><p class="role" id="role"></p>
    <div class="btns"><a class="plasma" href="#projects">View Projects</a><a class="ghost" href="#contact">Get in Touch</a></div></div>
  <div class="idwrap" id="idwrap"><div class="lanyard" id="lanyard">
    <div class="strap"></div><div class="clip"></div>
    <div class="idcard" id="idcard"><span class="slot"></span>
      <div class="idtop"><b>PORTFOLIO ID</b><i>SWE &bull; DIU</i></div>
      <div class="idphoto"><img id="photo" alt="Profile photo" draggable="false"></div>
      <div class="idname" id="idName"></div><div class="idrole" id="idRole"></div>
      <div class="idbar"><span>DHAKA, BD</span><div class="bars"></div></div>
      <div class="shine"></div>
    </div></div></div>
</div></section>

<section class="scene" id="about"><div class="in-wrap"><div class="panel rv"><h2>About <span class="grad">me</span></h2><div class="two"><div id="aboutText"></div><div class="facts" id="facts"></div></div></div></div></section>
<section class="scene" id="education"><div class="in-wrap"><div class="panel rv"><h2>Education</h2><div class="timeline" id="timeline"></div></div></div></section>
<section class="scene" id="skills"><div class="in-wrap"><div class="panel rv"><h2>Skills</h2><div id="skillBox"></div></div></div></section>
<section class="scene" id="projects"><div class="in-wrap"><div class="panel rv"><h2>Projects</h2><div class="pstack" id="pstack" tabindex="0" aria-label="Projects. Use arrow keys or drag to browse."></div>
  <div class="pnav"><button class="btn" id="pPrev" aria-label="Previous project">&larr;</button><span id="pCount"></span><button class="btn" id="pNext" aria-label="Next project">&rarr;</button></div></div></div></section>
<section class="scene" id="contact"><div class="in-wrap"><div class="panel rv"><h2>Get in <span class="grad">touch</span></h2><div class="two">
  <form id="form"><input name="n" placeholder="Your name" required><input name="e" type="email" placeholder="Your email" required><textarea name="m" rows="5" placeholder="Message" required></textarea><button class="plasma" type="submit">Send message</button></form>
  <div class="social" id="social"></div></div></div></div></section>
</main>

<script>
/* ===== EDIT HERE: change your details in this block ===== */
const C = {
  name: "ESHA SALMITH", eyebrow: "SOFTWARE ENGINEERING STUDENT",
  role: "B.Sc. in Software Engineering at Daffodil International University. I build clean, scalable software and enjoy solving hard problems.",
  photo: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", email: "s26284433@gmail.com",
  about: ["I'm a Software Engineering student at Daffodil International University (DIU), focused on problem-solving, software architecture and web application development.", "I like turning complicated ideas into simple, reliable software, and I keep learning new tools along the way."],
  facts: [["Studying", "B.Sc. in Software Engineering, DIU"], ["Based in", "Dhaka, Bangladesh"], ["Status", "Open to internships"]],
  education: [{year:"Present",title:"B.Sc. in Software Engineering",place:"Daffodil International University (DIU)"},{year:"2023",title:"HSC",place:"Uttara High School and College"},{year:"2021",title:"SSC",place:"B H Khan School and College"}],
  skills: {"Languages":["JavaScript","Python","C++","Java"],"Web":["HTML/CSS","React","Node.js","Tailwind"],"Tools & Databases":["Git","GitHub","MySQL","MongoDB"]},
  projects: [{title:"Dashing Travesseiro",desc:"JavaScript web project, deployed live on Netlify. Open the live demo or the source code.",github:"https://github.com/Onehpshihab0203/dashing-travesseiro-da541d",demo:"https://dashing-travesseiro-da541d.netlify.app/",img:""},{title:"Project Two",desc:"Add a short description from the admin panel.",github:"",demo:"",img:""},{title:"Project Three",desc:"Add a short description from the admin panel.",github:"",demo:"",img:""}],
  social: [{label:"GitHub",url:"https://github.com/Onehpshihab0203"},{label:"LinkedIn",url:"https://www.linkedin.com/in/esha-salmith-105321388/"},{label:"Facebook",url:"https://www.facebook.com/shihab.0203"}]
};
/* ===== end editable block ===== */
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id), esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
const LS = "esha_portfolio_v1", PASS = "0203";
try { const s = localStorage.getItem(LS); if (s) Object.assign(C, JSON.parse(s)); } catch (e) {}
const url = u => { u = String(u || "").trim(); return /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:)/i.test(u) ? u : (u ? "https://" + u.replace(/^[a-z]+:\/*/i, "") : ""); };
let cur = 0;
function render() {
  document.title = C.name + " | Portfolio";
  $("name").textContent = C.name; $("eyebrow").textContent = C.eyebrow; $("role").textContent = C.role; $("photo").src = C.photo;
  $("idName").textContent = C.name; $("idRole").textContent = C.eyebrow;
  $("aboutText").innerHTML = C.about.map(p => `<p>${esc(p)}</p>`).join("");
  $("facts").innerHTML = C.facts.map(f => `<div><span>${esc(String(f[0]).toUpperCase())}</span>${esc(f[1])}</div>`).join("");
  $("timeline").innerHTML = C.education.map(e => `<div class="step"><div class="yr">${esc(e.year)}</div><h3>${esc(e.title)}</h3><p>${esc(e.place)}</p></div>`).join("");
  $("skillBox").innerHTML = Object.entries(C.skills).map(([k, v]) => `<div class="skillgrp"><h3>${esc(k)}</h3><div class="chips">${v.map(s => `<span class="chip">${esc(s)}</span>`).join("")}</div></div>`).join("");
  renderProjects();
  $("social").innerHTML = [{label:"Email",url:"mailto:"+C.email}, ...C.social].map(s => `<a href="${esc(url(s.url))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${esc(s.label)}</a>`).join("");
  $("foot").textContent = "\u00A9 " + new Date().getFullYear() + " " + C.name;
}
function renderProjects() {
  const n = C.projects.length;
  $("pstack").innerHTML = C.projects.map((p, i) => `<article class="pk" data-i="${i}"><div class="pkimg">${p.img ? `<img src="${esc(url(p.img))}" alt="">` : `<span>PROJECT ${String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span>`}</div><h3>${esc(p.title)}</h3><p>${esc(p.desc)}</p><div class="plinks">${p.github ? `<a href="${esc(url(p.github))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">GitHub</a>` : ""}${p.demo ? `<a href="${esc(url(p.demo))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Live demo &nearr;</a>` : ""}</div></article>`).join("");
  if (cur >= n) cur = 0;
  layoutStack();
}
function layoutStack() {
  const cs = [...$("pstack").children], n = cs.length;
  cs.forEach((el, i) => { const o = (i - cur + n) % n;
    el.style.zIndex = n - o; el.style.opacity = o > 3 ? 0 : (1 - o * .2).toFixed(2);
    el.style.pointerEvents = o === 0 ? "auto" : "none";
    if (o !== 0) { el.style.setProperty("--rx", "0deg"); el.style.setProperty("--ry", "0deg"); }
    el.style.transform = `translate3d(${o * 28}px, ${o * -20}px, ${o * -80}px) rotateZ(${o * 2.4}deg) rotateX(var(--rx,0deg)) rotateY(var(--ry,0deg))`;
    el.classList.toggle("front", o === 0); });
  $("pCount").textContent = n ? `${cur + 1} / ${n}` : "";
}
render();
$("form").addEventListener("submit", e => { e.preventDefault(); const f = e.target;
  location.href = `mailto:${C.email}?subject=${encodeURIComponent("Portfolio message from " + f.n.value)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(f.m.value + "\n\n" + f.n.value + " (" + f.e.value + ")")}`; });

/* scroll world: sky gradient shifts from sky blue dusk to indigo to black, layers move at different speeds */
const reduce = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
const stars = $("stars"); stars.innerHTML = Array.from({length: 70}, () => `<i style="left:${Math.random()*100}%;top:${Math.random()*70}%;animation-delay:${(Math.random()*3).toFixed(1)}s"></i>`).join("");
const hx = h => [1, 3, 5].map(i => parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
const stops = [["#0b3a6e", "#38bdf8"], ["#1a1a5e", "#6366f1"], ["#04050f", "#16184a"]].map(s => s.map(hx));
const mix = (a, b, t) => a.map((v, i) => Math.round(v + (b[i] - v) * t));
let mx = 0, my = 0;
function update() {
  const max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight, p = max > 0 ? Math.min(1, scrollY / max) : 0;
  const seg = p * 2, i = Math.min(1, Math.floor(seg)), t = seg - i;
  const top = mix(stops[i][0], stops[i + 1][0], t), bot = mix(stops[i][1], stops[i + 1][1], t);
  $("stage").style.background = `linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(${top}) 0%, rgb(${bot}) 100%)`;
  $("stars").style.opacity = Math.max(0, (p - .25) * 1.6).toFixed(2);
  $("l1").style.transform = `translate(${mx * -10}px, ${-p * 40 + my * -4}px)`;
  $("l2").style.transform = `translate(${mx * -22}px, ${-p * 90 + my * -8}px)`;
  $("l3").style.transform = `translate(${mx * -38}px, ${-p * 150 + my * -12}px)`;
  $("prog").style.width = (p * 100) + "%";
}
addEventListener("scroll", update, { passive: true }); addEventListener("resize", update);
if (!reduce) addEventListener("pointermove", e => { mx = e.clientX / innerWidth - .5; my = e.clientY / innerHeight - .5; update(); });
update();

/* code rain: falling code characters in the background */
const cc = $("code"), g = cc.getContext("2d"), CH = "{}[]()<>/=;:+-*&|!?#$%01abcdefnlt";
let cw, chh, cols = [];
function csz() { cw = cc.width = innerWidth; chh = cc.height = innerHeight;
  cols = Array.from({ length: Math.floor(cw / 20) }, (_, i) => ({ x: i * 20 + 3, y: -Math.random() * chh, s: .7 + Math.random() * 1.8, gy: 0, c: i % 3 === 0 ? "#818cf8" : "#7dd3fc" })); }
csz(); addEventListener("resize", csz);
function rain() {
  g.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out"; g.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.09)"; g.fillRect(0, 0, cw, chh);
  g.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over"; g.font = "15px ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace";
  cols.forEach(c => { c.y += c.s; const gy = Math.floor(c.y / 18) * 18;
    if (gy !== c.gy) { c.gy = gy; g.fillStyle = Math.random() < .05 ? "#fff" : c.c; g.fillText(CH[Math.random() * CH.length | 0], c.x, gy); }
    if (c.y > chh + Math.random() * 700) c.y = -20; });
  requestAnimationFrame(rain);
}
if (!reduce) rain();

/* dock: items drop and widen near the pointer */
const items = [...document.querySelectorAll("#dock a")].map(el => ({ el, v: 0, vel: 0 })); let px = -999, py = -999;
addEventListener("pointermove", e => { px = e.clientX; py = e.clientY; });
(function tick() { items.forEach(it => { const r = it.el.getBoundingClientRect(), d = Math.hypot(px - (r.left + r.width / 2), py - (r.top + r.height / 2));
  const t = reduce ? 0 : Math.max(0, 1 - d / 122); it.vel = (it.vel + (t - it.v) * .19) * .70; it.v += it.vel;
  it.el.style.transform = `translateY(${(3.5 * it.v).toFixed(2)}px) scale(${(1 + .17 * it.v).toFixed(3)},${(1 + .16 * it.v).toFixed(3)})`; });
  requestAnimationFrame(tick); })();

const io = new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(x => { if (x.isIntersecting) { x.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(x.target); } }), { threshold: .15 });
document.querySelectorAll(".rv").forEach(el => io.observe(el));

/* ID card: hangs from a strap, follows the pointer, drag it to swing */
(function () {
  const wrap = $("idwrap"), lan = $("lanyard"), card = $("idcard");
  let ang = 0, vel = 0, drag = false;
  lan.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { drag = true; px = e.clientX; py = e.clientY; lan.classList.add("drag"); try { lan.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {} });
  const up = () => { drag = false; lan.classList.remove("drag"); };
  addEventListener("pointerup", up); addEventListener("pointercancel", up);
  if (reduce) return;
  (function loop(t) {
    const r = wrap.getBoundingClientRect(), pvx = r.left + r.width / 2, pvy = r.top;
    if (drag) { const tg = Math.max(-38, Math.min(38, Math.atan2(px - pvx, Math.max(60, py - pvy)) * 180 / Math.PI)); vel += (tg - ang) * .14; vel *= .78; }
    else { const tg = mx * 22 + Math.sin(t / 1100) * 1.6; vel += (tg - ang) * .03; vel *= .93; }
    ang += vel;
    lan.style.transform = `rotate(${ang.toFixed(2)}deg)`;
    const ry = Math.max(-30, Math.min(30, mx * 26 - vel * 4)), rx = -my * 16;
    card.style.transform = `perspective(800px) rotateY(${ry.toFixed(1)}deg) rotateX(${rx.toFixed(1)}deg)`;
    card.style.setProperty("--sh", (50 + ry * 1.6).toFixed(0) + "%");
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  })(0);
})();

/* project stack: tilt, drag, arrows, keyboard */
(function () {
  const st = $("pstack");
  const go = d => { const n = C.projects.length; if (n < 2) return; cur = (cur + d + n) % n; layoutStack(); };
  $("pPrev").onclick = () => go(-1); $("pNext").onclick = () => go(1);
  st.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "ArrowRight") go(1); if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") go(-1); });
  st.addEventListener("pointermove", e => { if (reduce) return; const f = st.querySelector(".pk.front"); if (!f) return; const r = st.getBoundingClientRect(), x = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - .5, y = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - .5;
    f.style.setProperty("--ry", (x * 14).toFixed(1) + "deg"); f.style.setProperty("--rx", (-y * 12).toFixed(1) + "deg"); });
  st.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { const f = st.querySelector(".pk.front"); if (f) { f.style.setProperty("--ry", "0deg"); f.style.setProperty("--rx", "0deg"); } });
  let sx = null; st.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { sx = e.clientX; });
  addEventListener("pointerup", e => { if (sx == null) return; const d = e.clientX - sx; sx = null; if (d < -60) go(1); else if (d > 60) go(-1); });
})();

/* admin panel */
(function () {
  const adm = $("admin"), box = $("admBody"); let pendingPhoto = null, tt;
  const toast = m => { const t = $("toast"); t.textContent = m; t.hidden = false; clearTimeout(tt); tt = setTimeout(() => t.hidden = true, 2600); };
  const persist = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(LS, JSON.stringify(C)); return true; } catch (e) { toast("Browser storage full. Use Download HTML."); return false; } };
  const openAdmin = () => { adm.hidden = false; document.body.style.overflow = "hidden"; showLogin(); };
  const closeAdmin = () => { adm.hidden = true; document.body.style.overflow = ""; };
  $("adminBtn").onclick = e => { e.preventDefault(); openAdmin(); };
  $("admBg").onclick = closeAdmin;
  addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Escape" && !adm.hidden) closeAdmin(); });
  const lines = s => s.split("\n").map(x => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const download = (name, text, type) => { const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text], { type })); a.download = name; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 4000); };

  function showLogin() {
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="admbar"><b>Admin login</b><button class="btn" id="aClose">Close</button></div><label>Password</label><input id="aPw" type="password" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Password"><p class="err" id="aErr"></p><div class="row"><button class="btn pri" id="aGo">Enter</button></div>`;
    $("aClose").onclick = closeAdmin;
    const go = () => { if ($("aPw").value === PASS) showEditor(); else { $("aErr").textContent = "Wrong password"; $("aPw").value = ""; } };
    $("aGo").onclick = go; $("aPw").onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === "Enter") go(); }; $("aPw").focus();
  }

  function addPj(p) {
    const d = document.createElement("div"); d.className = "apj";
    d.innerHTML = `<label>Title</label><input data-k="title"><label>Description</label><textarea data-k="desc" rows="2"></textarea><label>GitHub link</label><input data-k="github"><label>Live link</label><input data-k="demo"><label>Image URL (optional)</label><input data-k="img"><div class="row"><button class="btn" data-up>Move up</button><button class="btn" data-rm>Remove</button></div>`;
    d.querySelectorAll("[data-k]").forEach(el => el.value = p[el.dataset.k] || "");
    d.querySelector("[data-rm]").onclick = () => d.remove();
    d.querySelector("[data-up]").onclick = () => { if (d.previousElementSibling) d.parentNode.insertBefore(d, d.previousElementSibling); };
    $("aPj").appendChild(d);
  }

  function collect() {
    C.name = $("aN").value.trim() || C.name; C.eyebrow = $("aE").value.trim(); C.role = $("aR").value.trim(); C.email = $("aM").value.trim() || C.email;
    if (pendingPhoto) C.photo = pendingPhoto;
    C.about = lines($("aA").value);
    C.facts = lines($("aF").value).map(l => l.split("|").map(x => x.trim())).filter(a => a[0]).map(a => [a[0], a[1] || ""]);
    C.education = lines($("aEd").value).map(l => l.split("|").map(x => x.trim())).map(a => ({ year: a[0] || "", title: a[1] || "", place: a[2] || "" }));
    C.skills = {}; lines($("aS").value).forEach(l => { const i = l.indexOf(":"); if (i > 0) C.skills[l.slice(0, i).trim()] = l.slice(i + 1).split(",").map(x => x.trim()).filter(Boolean); });
    C.social = lines($("aSo").value).map(l => { const i = l.indexOf("|"); return { label: (i < 0 ? l : l.slice(0, i)).trim(), url: i < 0 ? "" : l.slice(i + 1).trim() }; }).filter(s => s.label && s.url);
    C.projects = [...document.querySelectorAll("#aPj .apj")].map(d => { const o = {}; d.querySelectorAll("[data-k]").forEach(el => o[el.dataset.k] = el.value.trim()); return o; }).filter(p => p.title);
  }

  async function exportHTML() {
    collect();
    let page = null;
    try { page = await (await fetch(location.href.split("#")[0], { cache: "no-store" })).text(); } catch (e) {}
    const A = "const C" + " = {", B = "/* ===== end editable" + " block";
    const i = page ? page.indexOf(A) : -1, j = page ? page.indexOf(B) : -1;
    if (i < 0 || j < i) { download("portfolio-data.json", JSON.stringify(C, null, 1), "application/json"); toast("Could not read page source here. Downloaded JSON instead."); return; }
    const out = page.slice(0, i) + "const C = " + JSON.stringify(C, null, 1).replace(/<\//g, "<\\/") + ";\n" + page.slice(j);
    download("index.html", out, "text/html"); toast("index.html downloaded. Upload it to Netlify.");
  }

  function showEditor() {
    pendingPhoto = null;
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="admbar"><b>Admin panel</b><span><button class="btn pri" id="aSave">Save</button> <button class="btn" id="aClose">Close</button></span></div>
<h3>PROFILE</h3><label>Name</label><input id="aN"><label>Small title above name</label><input id="aE"><label>Intro text</label><textarea id="aR" rows="3"></textarea>
<label>Email</label><input id="aM" type="email"><label>Change profile photo</label><input id="aP" type="file" accept="image/*">
<h3>ABOUT</h3><label>One paragraph per line</label><textarea id="aA" rows="5"></textarea><label>Quick facts (Label | Value)</label><textarea id="aF" rows="3"></textarea>
<h3>EDUCATION</h3><label>Year | Title | Place</label><textarea id="aEd" rows="4"></textarea>
<h3>SKILLS</h3><label>Group: skill, skill, skill</label><textarea id="aS" rows="4"></textarea>
<h3>PROJECTS</h3><div id="aPj"></div><div class="row"><button class="btn" id="aAdd">+ Add project</button></div>
<h3>SOCIAL LINKS</h3><label>Label | URL</label><textarea id="aSo" rows="4"></textarea>
<h3>PUBLISH / BACKUP</h3><div class="row"><button class="btn pri" id="aHtml">Download updated index.html</button><button class="btn" id="aJson">Export JSON</button><button class="btn" id="aImp">Import JSON</button><button class="btn" id="aReset">Reset</button></div>
<p class="note">Save keeps your changes in this browser only. For everyone to see them, press Download updated index.html and upload that file to Netlify.</p><input id="aFile" type="file" accept="application/json" hidden>`;
    $("aN").value = C.name; $("aE").value = C.eyebrow; $("aR").value = C.role; $("aM").value = C.email;
    $("aA").value = C.about.join("\n"); $("aF").value = C.facts.map(f => f.join(" | ")).join("\n");
    $("aEd").value = C.education.map(e => [e.year, e.title, e.place].join(" | ")).join("\n");
    $("aS").value = Object.entries(C.skills).map(([k, v]) => k + ": " + v.join(", ")).join("\n");
    $("aSo").value = C.social.map(s => s.label + " | " + s.url).join("\n");
    C.projects.forEach(addPj);
    $("aAdd").onclick = () => addPj({});
    $("aClose").onclick = closeAdmin;
    $("aSave").onclick = () => { collect(); render(); if (persist()) toast("Saved"); };
    $("aHtml").onclick = exportHTML;
    $("aJson").onclick = () => { collect(); download("portfolio-data.json", JSON.stringify(C, null, 1), "application/json"); };
    $("aImp").onclick = () => $("aFile").click();
    $("aFile").onchange = e => { const f = e.target.files[0]; if (!f) return; const r = new FileReader(); r.onload = () => { try { Object.assign(C, JSON.parse(r.result)); render(); persist(); showEditor(); toast("Imported"); } catch (_) { toast("Invalid JSON file"); } }; r.readAsText(f); };
    $("aReset").onclick = () => { if (confirm("Remove all saved changes in this browser?")) { try { localStorage.removeItem(LS); } catch (_) {} location.reload(); } };
    $("aP").onchange = e => { const f = e.target.files[0]; if (!f) return; const r = new FileReader();
      r.onload = () => { const im = new Image(); im.onload = () => { const s = Math.min(1, 720 / Math.max(im.width, im.height)), c = document.createElement("canvas"); c.width = Math.round(im.width * s); c.height = Math.round(im.height * s); c.getContext("2d").drawImage(im, 0, 0, c.width, c.height); pendingPhoto = c.toDataURL("image/jpeg", .88); toast("Photo ready. Press Save."); }; im.src = r.result; };
      r.readAsDataURL(f); };
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
